subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum rate of interest for the period from 3 February 2023 to 17 April 2023.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Days from 3 Feb to 17 Apr = 73 days

SI = P × R × T / 100

T = 73/365 = 1/5 year

SI = 2000 × 7 × (1/5) / 100 = 28

**∴ Answer = ₹28**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 2000

Rate = 7% per annum

Time = from 3 Feb 2023 to 17 Apr 2023

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Feb: 25 days (from 3 to 28)

⇒ March: 31 days

⇒ April: 17 days

⇒ Total days = 25 + 31 + 17 = 73 days

⇒ Time in years = 73 / 365 = 1/5

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7 × 1/5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 14000 / 500

⇒ SI = 28

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Time Conversion

Number of days ÷ 365 gives time in years.

Calendar Tip

Always count exact days for accurate SI calculation.

17
